mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.address_id, s.name, s.description, s.phone, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM store s JOIN root r ON s.id = r.id AND r.type = 'STORE' AND ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT s.id, s.address_id, s.name, s.description, s.phone, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM store s JOIN root r ON s.id = r.id AND r.type = 'STORE' AND WHERE s.id = #{storeId}
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM store s JOIN root r ON s.id = r.id AND r.type = 'STORE' AND WHERE s.id = #{storeId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store (id, address_id, name, description, phone) VALUES (#{id}, #{addressId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{phone})
mapper.update: UPDATE store s JOIN root r ON s.id = r.id AND r.type = 'STORE' AND SET s.address_id = #{store.addressId}, s.name = #{store.name}, s.description = #{store.description}, s.phone = #{store.phone}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE s.id = #{storeId}
UPDATE store s JOIN root r ON s.id = r.id AND r.type = 'STORE' AND SET r.deleted_at = NOW() WHERE s.id = #{storeId}
